topic: gh_config_dir checks: path race, ACLs and budget key (security audit, low)
detail: SP-074 audit of PR #182: github.CheckProfileDir resolves symbolic links to check the directory, but gh is started with the unresolved gh_config_dir, so a link swapped between the check and the run is not caught; macOS ACLs are not checked; the hourly budget is keyed on the gh_config_dir string, so two spellings of one folder would get two budgets (validation only rejects equal expanded paths). Proposed: pass the resolved path as GH_CONFIG_DIR, reject folders with an extended ACL, key the budget on the resolved path.
